composite_title: LIP-0011 — sign, choose D-1, authorise the touch
composite_question: The P1-exit verdicts said what; LIP-0011 says it exactly. Measuring it found four things the verdicts could not have known: two topology encodings in our own code (F-V-10), generator as our own invention (F-V-11), the hard topology check as a proxy made a MUST (F-V-12), and a misreading in the LIP's first draft that a peer caught (F-V-13). Composite approve = sign LIP-0011 with your per-section answers.

sections.title: §1–§5 · The definitions, made exact
sections.question: Sign LIP-0011 §1–§5 as written: sync_hash byte for byte (+ test vector), sync.source_sha256, sync.generator, A-8 at extended. Approve = your §7.7 signature on the specification (D-1 and the firewall table are separate sections below). Amend = name the clause in the note. Discuss = hold.
sections.analysis:
• §1 sync_hash = canvas_std.compute_sync_hash over the source topology, with the payload stated byte for byte: ids joined by U+0001, then U+0002, then the from->to pairs joined by U+0001, sha256, first 16 lowercase hex. Test vector: a,b, edge a→b ⇒ 097164175d271fb8.
  • F-V-13, a correction caught before you saw it: the first draft read the invisible separators as empty strings, giving the wrong hash 5d3a8a0c81db08d9 and a false collision claim. Noether's memo of 10-15 (LP F-AC-41) named exactly this trap. It is fixed and struck in the LIP, not hidden.
  • §2 sync.source_sha256: optional, 64 lowercase hex, sha256 of the source's bytes. City and LP already write it, both well-formed.
  • §4 sync.generator: an optional non-empty string. The top-level _reserved.generator is deprecated, not invalid. F-V-11: 61 canvases carry it and the original is ours (PresentationBuilder), not Terminal's. RESERVED_KEYS stays at 11.
  • §5 A-8 runs at extended whenever a _reserved block is present. core is unchanged, so the 414 template-legacy canvases are untouched.
  • Additive ⇒ v2.4.0 → v2.5.0. Full text: who/governance/lips/lip_0011_sync_semantics.md.

recommendation.rationale: Each clause is a ruled verdict made precise; the only new content is the byte-exact encoding and its test vector, which a peer asked for.
key_factors: Three of four asking vaults already aligned (LP and City already emit it)
Test vector makes the Standard checkable without our code
risks: Terminal reads stale (advisory) until its one regeneration after P4
next_actions: P4 memos carry the signed LIP

sections.title: D-1 · Topology mismatch: warning or error?
sections.question: When production: generated, is a topology mismatch a warning or an error at adna_native? Approve = (i): advisory at both tiers in v2.5.0 (recommended — a departure from the P1-exit door's sub-recommendation, on new evidence). Amend = (ii): hard at adna_native, as the P1-exit door recommended; write “(ii)” in the note. Discuss = hold.
sections.analysis:
• Measured (F-V-12): 20 adna_native generated canvases fleet-wide; 16 match. The 4 that don't: 2 RLHF fixtures in the builder encoding (F-V-10: CanvasBuilder hashes JSON, not the Standard's payload), 1 canvas_std test fixture with a hand-set hash, 1 QuantumProteins canvas that already fails. 0 external canvases would newly fail under (ii).
  • Why (i) anyway: “the stored hash equals the canvas's own topology” is only true for views that preserve the source's nodes. As a MUST, it forbids any generator from ever adding a decorative node — a constraint no vault has been asked about. Hardening later takes a one-line LIP; un-hardening is a breaking change.
  • Why (ii) is respectable: it is stronger today, costs only Canvas's own three canvases, and catches stale generated views at validation time.
  • Either way, F-V-10 is fixed: CanvasBuilder delegates to canvas_std and the three artifacts are regenerated (outside the firewall, ours).

recommendation.rationale: Report the proxy now, harden it when the measured advisory count at adna_native is zero.
key_factors: Keeps v2.5.0 additive in fact, not only in name
risks: A stale generated adna_native view passes with a warning until hardened
next_actions: Census re-run at the touch reports the advisory count
Hardening becomes a backlog idea gated on that count = 0
